question: what are the steps to measuring Instantaneous irrigation application rates?
gold_answers: (1) Identify the areas of the irrigated system that has the application rate. (Fastest travel or shortest application time, further watered point from center not affected by the end gun on center pivots)
(2) With the machine running at a known rate flag the point just ahead of the wetted front.
(3) Record the amount of time in minutes and seconds from the first splash of water to hit the flag till the last splash, as the machine passes
(4) Convert your application to minute per one inch application.
predicted_answer: Identify the areas of the irrigated system that has the application rate
